create_SparsificationSummaries_from_modu: create SparsificationSummaries from a PyTorch module to get quantized and pruned operation counts
create_SparsificationPruning_from_module: create SparsificationPruning from a PyTorch module to get per-parameter zero-weight counts and percentages
create_SparsificationQuantization_from_m: create SparsificationQuantization from a PyTorch module to get per-operation quantization status and precision info
summarize_SparsificationSummaries_loggab: summarize SparsificationSummaries loggable items to yield operation counts, parameter counts, and pruning percentages
filter_SparsificationInfo_loggable_items: filter SparsificationInfo loggable items by percentage-only or non-zero-only criteria
